issues: 全屏特写和网格都是灰色占位卡（灰条代替文字），观众看不出飞回去的是什么
特写卡比例与画面不一致，全屏时内容被裁切
卡片无动机地自己飞走，落座也没有"到家"的反馈
整体浅灰底 + 默认靛蓝，没有光、没有材质
changes: look 改为 sand：虚构旅行手账 App「Wayfare」的「Saved trips」总览，3×2 张程序绘制的分层山景卡（天空渐变 + 太阳 + 三层山脊视差漂移），标题直接压在画面上
卡片改为 16:9（528×297），全屏特写就是这张卡 ×3.64（CSS zoom 布局级放大，132px 标题不糊），内容零重排
加叙事因果：特写左上「‹ Saved trips」返回键先按下（缩 8% + 提亮）、chrome 淡出，34f 卡片才起飞
位置/尺寸/圆角共用一条物理弹簧（~21f 到位），过冲段按 0.3 压缩成 ≈2% 尺寸回弹；投影从悬浮级收敛到贴地级，背景网格 1.035→1 后拉
落座余波：邻卡由近及远错峰提亮并被径向推开 11px、两拍收敛——网格被这张卡的落地轻轻撞了一下；落定后整幅 1→1.012 缓推
issuesEn: Both the fullscreen detail and the grid are grey placeholder cards (bars instead of text) — you can't tell what is flying home
The detail card's aspect ratio doesn't match the frame, so content gets cropped at fullscreen
The card flies away with no motivation and the landing gives no 'home' feedback
Flat light-grey background with default indigo; no light, no material
changesEn: Look switched to sand: the 'Saved trips' overview of a fictional travel journal app 'Wayfare', with 3×2 procedurally drawn layered landscape cards (sky gradient, sun, three parallax ridges) and titles set on the art
Cards are 16:9 (528×297) so the fullscreen detail is literally the same card ×3.64 via CSS zoom (crisp 132px title), zero relayout
Added cause and effect: the '‹ Saved trips' back button is pressed (8% squash + brighten), detail chrome fades, then the card takes off at 34f
Position/size/radius share one physical spring (~21f to land) with the overshoot compressed ×0.3 to a ~2% size bounce; shadow settles from hover to resting, grid pulls back 1.035→1
Landing aftermath: neighbours light up near-to-far and get pushed out radially by 11px, settling in two beats — the grid feels the card land; then a slow 1→1.012 push
